request.description:
Submit one or more Energy, FCAS, or MNSP Bids. It supports:

- Bids and Offers for multiple Trading Days, DUIDs (Dispatchable Unit or MSNP Interconnector ID), and FCAS Service Type.
- Provision of Energy, FCAS, and MNSP bids/offers in the same submission.
- Separate formats for Energy, FCAS, or MNSP bids/offers so you don't need to include unrequired fields.

You provide the Bid/Offer details in the energyBids, fcasBids, or mnspBids arrays in the JSON schema.

This endpoint has payload parameters only (no query parameters).
